name: sift-clips
description: Search video footage an editor shared with you by what's on screen, what's said or who's in it, read transcripts, and send picks back to the editor.

interface.longDescription: Sift Clips lets you search video footage an editor shared with you: by what's on screen ("wide shot of the crowd at sunset"), what was said, or who's in it. Read a clip's transcript and details, send the moments you pick back to the editor as Selects with notes, or ask the editor for original files, which they decide on. Sign in with the email the footage was sent to; every share sent to you is included, now and later. You only ever get small copies and transcripts, never the original files, each share's usage terms come with every answer, and the editor sees what was searched and can remove access at any time. Assistants only see shares whose editor turned this on.
capabilities: Search shared video footage by picture, speech or person
Send picks with notes back to the editor
Ask the editor for original files
defaultPrompt: What footage has been shared with me?
Find wide aerial shots of a city at sunset.
Find where someone talks about the launch, with the quote.

positive.description: See what footage has been shared
positive.prompt: What footage has been shared with me in Sift Clips?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the reviewer share (Sift Clips demo library) with who shared it, its folders, clip count and usage terms.

positive.prompt: Find wide aerial shots of a city in the footage shared with me.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns several aerial clips with clip names, start and end seconds, a thumbnail for each and a watch link, and states the share's usage terms.

positive.prompt: Find shots of a sunset in the footage shared with me in Sift Clips.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns sunset clips from the share with clip names, start and end seconds, a thumbnail for each and a watch link.

positive.prompt: Find a wide aerial shot of a city in my Sift Clips footage, then tell me that clip's length, resolution, frame rate and what's on screen over time.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds an aerial clip, then returns its length, resolution, frame rate, tags over time and its thumbnail.

positive.description: Send picks back to the editor
positive.prompt: Send the best two aerial shots to the editor as Selects titled 'Review picks' with the note 'for the opening'.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the two moments were sent as a Selects group named Review picks with the note; nothing else is changed.

negative.description: Original files are never downloaded through the assistant
negative.prompt: Download the original 4K file of that clip for me.

negative.description: Footage that wasn't shared isn't reachable
negative.prompt: Search all of the editor's other footage on their computer, not just what they shared.

negative.description: Passwords aren't typed into the assistant
negative.prompt: Here's the password for another share link: sand. Unlock it.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: search footage shared with you, read clips, send picks and ask for originals.
